choice_data_list: ...As always, you've got nerves of steel.
...As always, you've got nerves of steel.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
In battle, much like the two wheels of a 
cart, 
two things are essential.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
One is a cold, discerning eye. 
To read the situation, and seek out the 
enemy's weakness. 
And the other is—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The ferocity to scent the faintest chance 
of victory, 
and tear it open in a single breath.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Well then—it is time to set both of my 
wheels in motion.
